title: Augustana Alumnae Rally Around Friend, Classmate in Her Final Year
summary_en: When an alumna was diagnosed with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, her fellow Augustana classmates didn’t think twice about rallying around her. Two Augustana alumnae — who had never even met — came together to be by their friend’s side.
title_cn: Augustana Alumnae Rally Around Friend, Classmate in Her Final Year
